The 'pinned' volatility regime with positive GEX suggests dealers are maintaining liquidity but market movement is constrained, while the BULL-DELUDED CAG reading indicates overconfident positioning despite underlying bearish signals. VIX at 17.81 shows moderate stress but the regime conflict suggests this could change rapidly as the market resolves the directional disagreement.
